coverage.notes: As of 20 October 2026, the most recent international undergraduate guide located is for 2026; no full 2027 entry catalogue or complete language filter was available for review. The 2026 catalogue PDF was indexed but direct opening returned 403, so programme-level English-medium completeness is not verified. A separately announced English-taught Digital Economy 2+2 dual-degree expects a 2027 cohort but requires two years at a partner university before SYSU and is excluded from school-leaver first-year entry. A SYSU pre-university route with a February 2027 semester is a non-degree preparation course, also excluded. Historic MBBS references cannot establish 2027 direct-entry availability. No in-scope programme is asserted until the 2027 catalogue is verified.
